I wrote `priorities.csv` in the working directory with the header `id,priority` and 39 rows, sorted by id.

I left out the 6 closed tickets: T-200, T-216, T-220, T-238 and T-242. The other 39 tickets are included.

I applied the rules by reading the file and checking each ticket by hand, not with a script. The outage and invoice/refund checks used whole-word matching. So "downtime" and "Breakdown" do not count as "down", and "Refunded?" does count as "refund" when it appears in the body. T-205 and T-241 ("Planned downtime") therefore get P4, not P2.
